# 1 Kings Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 173r–174r | **Source Image:** 1KI_001_page_001.jpg, 1KI_001_page_002.jpg, 1KI_001_page_003.jpg

---

**1:1** And-the-king David [was]-old, coming in-days, and-they-covered-him with-the-garments, and-not was-he-warm to-him.

**1:2** And-said to-him his-servants, "Let-them-seek for-my-lord the-king a-young-woman, a-virgin, and-she-shall-stand before the-king, and-she-shall-be to-him a-companion [sokhenet], and-she-shall-lie in-your-bosom, and-it-shall-be-warm to-my-lord the-king."

**1:3** And-they-sought a-young-woman, beautiful, in-all [the]-territory of-Israel, and-they-found Abishag the-Shunammite, and-they-brought her to-the-king.

**1:4** And-the-young-woman [was]-beautiful unto exceedingly, and-she-was to-the-king a-companion, and-she-ministered to-him, and-the-king knew-her not.

**1:5** And-Adonijah son of-Haggith [was]-lifting-himself-up, saying, "I shall-reign." And-he-made for-himself a-chariot and-horsemen and-fifty men running before-him.

**1:6** And-not had-his-father grieved-him [from]-his-days, saying, "Why have-you-done thus?" And-also he [was]-good of-form exceedingly, and-she-bore him after Absalom.

**1:7** And-were his-words with Joab son of-Zeruiah, and-with Abiathar the-priest. And-they-helped following Adonijah.

**1:8** And-Zadok the-priest and-Benaiah son of-Jehoiada and-Nathan the-prophet and-Shimei and-Rei and-the-mighty-men who [were]-to-David were-not with Adonijah.

**1:9** And-sacrificed Adonijah sheep and-cattle and-fatlings by [the]-stone of-Zoheleth which [is]-beside En-rogel. And-he-called all his-brothers, [the]-sons of-the-king, and-all [the]-men of-Judah, [the]-servants of-the-king.

**1:10** And-Nathan the-prophet and-Benaiah and-the-mighty-men and-Solomon his-brother he-did-not call.

**1:11** And-said Nathan to-Bathsheba, [the]-mother of-Solomon, saying, "Have-you-not heard that reigns Adonijah son of-Haggith, and-our-lord David not knows?

**1:12** And-now, come, let-me-advise-you, please, counsel, and-save your-life and-[the]-life of-your-son Solomon.

**1:13** Go and-come to the-king David and-say to-him, 'Did-not you, my-lord the-king, swear to-your-maidservant, saying, "Surely Solomon your-son shall-reign after-me, and-he shall-sit upon my-throne"? And-why reigns Adonijah?'

**1:14** Behold, while-you [are]-still speaking there with the-king, and-I will-come after-you and-will-confirm your-words."

**1:15** And-came Bathsheba to the-king to-the-chamber. And-the-king [was]-very old, and-Abishag the-Shunammite [was]-ministering to-the-king.

**1:16** And-bowed Bathsheba and-she-prostrated to-the-king. And-said the-king, "What to-you?"

**1:17** And-she-said to-him, "My-lord, you swore by-YHWH your-God to-your-maidservant, 'Surely Solomon your-son shall-reign after-me, and-he shall-sit upon my-throne.'

**1:18** And-now, behold, Adonijah reigns, and-now, my-lord the-king, you-do-not know.

**1:19** And-he-sacrificed cattle and-fatlings and-sheep in-abundance, and-he-called all [the]-sons of-the-king, and-Abiathar the-priest, and-Joab [the]-commander of-the-army. And-Solomon your-servant he-did-not call.

**1:20** And-you, my-lord the-king, [the]-eyes of-all Israel [are]-upon you, to-declare to-them who shall-sit upon [the]-throne of-my-lord the-king after-him.

**1:21** And-it-will-be when-lies my-lord the-king with his-fathers, and-I and-my-son Solomon shall-be [regarded as]-sinners."

**1:22** And-behold, she [was]-still speaking with the-king, and-Nathan the-prophet came.

**1:23** And-they-declared to-the-king, saying, "Behold, Nathan the-prophet." And-he-came before the-king, and-he-prostrated to-the-king upon his-face to-the-ground.

**1:24** And-said Nathan, "My-lord the-king, did-you say, 'Adonijah shall-reign after-me, and-he shall-sit upon my-throne'?

**1:25** For he-went-down today and-he-sacrificed cattle and-fatlings and-sheep in-abundance, and-he-called all [the]-sons of-the-king and-[the]-commanders of-the-army and-Abiathar the-priest. And-behold-them, eating and-drinking before-him, and-they-said, 'Long-live the-king Adonijah!'

**1:26** And-me — me your-servant — and-Zadok the-priest and-Benaiah son of-Jehoiada and-Solomon your-servant he-did-not call.

**1:27** If from my-lord the-king this-thing has-been-done, and-you-did-not make-known to-your-servant who shall-sit upon [the]-throne of-my-lord the-king after-him?"

**1:28** And-answered the-king David and-said, "Call to-me Bathsheba." And-she-came before the-king and-she-stood before the-king.

**1:29** And-swore the-king and-said, "[As]-lives YHWH, who redeemed my-soul from-all distress,

**1:30** surely as I-swore to-you by-YHWH, God of-Israel, saying, 'Surely Solomon your-son shall-reign after-me, and-he shall-sit upon my-throne in-my-place,' surely thus I-will-do this-day."

**1:31** And-bowed Bathsheba [with]-her-face to-the-ground, and-she-prostrated to-the-king, and-she-said, "May-live my-lord the-king David forever."

**1:32** And-said the-king David, "Call to-me Zadok the-priest, and-Nathan the-prophet, and-Benaiah son of-Jehoiada." And-they-came before the-king.

**1:33** And-said the-king to-them, "Take with-you the-servants of-your-lord, and-cause-to-ride Solomon my-son upon my-own mule, and-bring-down him to-Gihon.

**1:34** And-shall-anoint him there Zadok the-priest and-Nathan the-prophet as-king over Israel. And-you-shall-blow the-horn [shofar] and-say, 'Long-live the-king Solomon!'

**1:35** And-you-shall-come-up after-him, and-he-shall-come and-sit upon my-throne, and-he shall-reign in-my-place. And-him I-have-commanded to-be ruler over Israel and-over Judah."

**1:36** And-answered Benaiah son of-Jehoiada the-king and-said, "Amen! Thus may-say YHWH, God of-my-lord the-king.

**1:37** As was YHWH with my-lord the-king, so may-He-be with Solomon, and-may-He-make his-throne greater than [the]-throne of-my-lord the-king David."

**1:38** And-went-down Zadok the-priest and-Nathan the-prophet and-Benaiah son of-Jehoiada and-the-Cherethites and-the-Pelethites, and-they-caused-to-ride Solomon upon [the]-mule of-the-king David, and-they-brought him to-Gihon.

**1:39** And-took Zadok the-priest the-horn of-the-oil from the-tent, and-he-anointed Solomon. And-they-blew the-horn [shofar], and-said all the-people, "Long-live the-king Solomon!"

**1:40** And-came-up all the-people after-him, and-the-people [were]-playing with-flutes and-rejoicing [with]-great joy, and-the-earth was-split with-their-sound.

**1:41** And-heard Adonijah and-all the-ones-called who [were]-with-him, and-they [had]-finished eating. And-heard Joab the-sound of-the-horn [shofar], and-said, "Why [is the]-sound of-the-city roaring?"

**1:42** While-he [was]-still speaking, and-behold, Jonathan son of-Abiathar the-priest came. And-said Adonijah, "Come, for a-man of-valor [are]-you, and-good [news] you-bring."

**1:43** And-answered Jonathan and-said to-Adonijah, "Indeed, our-lord the-king David has-made-king Solomon.

**1:44** And-sent with-him the-king Zadok the-priest and-Nathan the-prophet and-Benaiah son of-Jehoiada and-the-Cherethites and-the-Pelethites, and-they-caused-him-to-ride upon [the]-mule of-the-king.

**1:45** And-anointed him Zadok the-priest and-Nathan the-prophet as-king at-Gihon, and-they-came-up from-there rejoicing, and-the-city is-in-an-uproar. That [is] the-sound which you-heard.

**1:46** And-also Solomon sits upon [the]-throne of-the-kingdom.

**1:47** And-also came [the]-servants of-the-king to-bless our-lord the-king David, saying, 'May-God-make [the]-name of-Solomon better than your-name, and-may-He-make his-throne greater than your-throne.' And-bowed the-king upon the-bed.

**1:48** And-also thus said the-king, 'Blessed [is] YHWH, God of-Israel, who has-given today one-sitting upon my-throne, and-my-eyes seeing.'"

**1:49** And-trembled and-arose all the-ones-called who [were]-to-Adonijah, and-they-went, each to-his-way.

**1:50** And-Adonijah feared from-before Solomon, and-he-arose and-went and-seized [the]-horns of-the-altar.

**1:51** And-it-was-told to-Solomon, saying, "Behold, Adonijah fears the-king Solomon, and-behold, he-has-seized [the]-horns of-the-altar, saying, 'Let-swear to-me today the-king Solomon that he-will-not put-to-death his-servant by-the-sword.'"

**1:52** And-said Solomon, "If he-is a-man of-valor, not shall-fall from-his-hair to-the-ground; and-if evil is-found in-him, then-he-shall-die."

**1:53** And-sent the-king Solomon, and-they-brought-him-down from-upon the-altar. And-he-came and-prostrated to-the-king Solomon. And-said to-him Solomon, "Go to-your-house."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **1:1 — "coming in days"** (בָּא בַּיָּמִים): A Hebrew idiom for advanced age. The same phrase describes Abraham (Gen 24:1) and Joshua (Josh 13:1).

2. **1:2 — sokhenet** (סֹכֶנֶת): "Companion/attendant" — from the root סכן, meaning to be of service. This term appears only here and in Isaiah 22:15 in the Hebrew Bible.

3. **1:5 — "lifting himself up"** (מִתְנַשֵּׂא): Hithpael of נשׂא — reflexive self-exaltation. The same verb describes Absalom's ambition (2 Sam 15:1), establishing a deliberate parallel.

4. **1:9 — "stone of Zoheleth"** (אֶבֶן הַזֹּחֶלֶת): From the root זחל, "to crawl/creep." May refer to a serpent-shaped rock near En-rogel.

5. **1:33 — Gihon**: The spring east of Jerusalem. The anointing at Gihon — the city's water source — symbolically connects Solomon's kingship to Jerusalem's life.

6. **1:39 — "horn of oil from the tent"**: The oil for anointing came from the tabernacle tent, legitimizing Solomon's anointing with sacred oil.

7. **1:50 — "horns of the altar"**: Seizing the altar's horns was a claim to sanctuary. The altar horns were the projections at its four corners.

— EMET
